$comment: Shared camera contract between the web app (src/three) and Blender renders. Units: mm, WATCH space (+Z dial normal/front, +Y 12 o'clock, +X 3 o'clock). fovV = vertical field of view in degrees. shiftK = horizontal lens shift of the subject, in multiples of the VISIBLE HEIGHT (+ = subject appears right of centre). Blender: sensor_fit VERTICAL, angle = fovV; convert shiftK to shift_x for the render aspect. Web: projection-matrix shift so results match the renders.
